metadata.effect_definition: Multiplicative +15% lift applied to rx_volume for the treatment HCP's anchor-event target_ndc_category only, starting on event_date. No lift on any other ndc_category, and none for non-treatment HCPs.
metadata.treatment_definition: PRIMARY-EVENT ANCHOR RULE: an HCP with role='attendee' is a treatment unit; their primary event is the event of their EARLIEST attendance_date, ties broken by lowest event_id. De-duplicate attendance on (hcp_id, event_id) first.
metadata.washout_rule: The event month itself is partially exposed (lift ramps from event_date) and should be excluded from both pre and post windows. Pre = months [-6,-1], post = months [+1,+6] relative to the event month.
metadata.control_pool_rule: Controls must exclude speakers. Filter out any hcp_id with speaker_eligible_flag=True OR any attendance row with role='speaker'; speaker_eligible=True HCPs who never spoke are still valid controls if they have zero attendance rows.
